source.title: DNT
source.description:
You find a small smooth purple stone. It has many irregular facets, the largest of which seems to house a cloudy mineral formation that you notice seems to shimmer and swirl slightly in the light. As you concentrate harder on that movement however, you feel an increasing sense of unease.

You are about to discard it when you have a sudden feeling, almost an urge to keep it with you for now.
